style.common: 16-bit SNES-era pixel art for a top-down turn-based historical strategy game in the spirit of Civilization. Crisp hard-edged square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, limited palette of about 24 colors, warm natural tones, consistent lighting from the top-left. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, border, frame, card, panel, UI elements or watermark.
style.terrain: Seamless tileable square ground texture seen straight down from high above like a map, filling the entire image edge to edge. Calm and LOW CONTRAST: mostly one flat base color with only sparse, small, subtle detail pixels in two or three close shades, so that game units placed on top stay clearly readable. Uniform density everywhere, no single object that stands out, no tall blades seen from the side, no vignette, no perspective, no horizon.
style.overlay: One single cluster seen from a 3/4 top-down view, centered, filling about 80% of the image width, 1-pixel dark outline around the whole cluster, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground patch, no grass, no cast shadow, nothing else on the background.
style.unit: One single game unit sprite, full body, 3/4 top-down view facing right, centered, filling about 75% of the image height, chunky readable silhouette, 1-pixel dark outline, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground, no shadow, no base, no pedestal, no extra objects.
style.city: One single compact walled town, 3/4 top-down view, centered, filling about 85% of the image width, 1-pixel dark outline around the whole town, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground plane, no roads leading out, no cast shadow.
style.resource: One single small icon object, centered, filling about 60% of the image, bold readable shape, 1-pixel dark outline, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground, no shadow.
style.improvement: One single small object, 3/4 top-down view, centered, filling about 70% of the image, bold readable shape, 1-pixel dark outline, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground patch, no grass, no shadow.
style.building: One single building, ancient Mediterranean / Kyivan Rus era, 3/4 top-down view from the front, centered, filling about 85% of the image width, 1-pixel dark outline around the whole building, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground patch, no grass, no people, no cast shadow.
style.house: One single building, ancient Mediterranean / Kyivan Rus era, 3/4 top-down view from the front, centered, filling about 85% of the image width, 1-pixel dark outline around the whole building, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No ground patch, no grass, no people, no cast shadow.
style.backdrop: Wide landscape backdrop for a city view screen, seen from slightly above. No buildings, no people, no animals, no roads.
